title: Rippling - Steep learning curve, stacking module fees, and an active espionage lawsuit with Deel
clean_text: Reddit and review themes describe Rippling as powerful but complex, with a steep learning curve for advanced features; most complaints center on pricing structure and time-to-learn rather than core functionality. Because pricing is modular (per-employee, per-module, plus a mandatory base platform fee), total cost depends heavily on which modules are added, and contracts carry a 5-7% annual price escalation at renewal. Separately, Rippling and competitor Deel are engaged in an ongoing legal battle: Rippling sued Deel in March 2025 alleging a planted corporate spy stole trade secrets including customer data and pricing strategies, and Deel countersued alleging a Rippling employee impersonated a Deel customer for six months to access its systems -- both sides have made serious, unresolved allegations against each other.
